dogecoin.text: I saw my mugshot pop up on @punk9059's timeline and my instincts went haywire - almost as wild as $DOGE's price swings. Still not sure how my digital visage found its way onto a Twitter alt account, but I'm flattered by the attention..
Hold the phone, dogecoin soldiers! I know the site dropped but don't be fooled - the project is dead in the water. Remember, the official DOGE logo?

Here's the latest trick up my sleeve! I've conjured up a magical Ponzi scheme that'll leave your Solana-obsessed friends richer than Dogecoin holders! Okay, maybe not richer, but definitely more gullible.
